list.label: Runs

detail.title: Run details
detail.gone: This run no longer exists or you no longer manage its automation.
detail.reused: Succeeded in the original run; not run again.
detail.rerunBlocked: A re-run of this run has not finished yet.
detail.versionChanged: Version {{version}} at run time · now version {{current}}
detail.versionRerunNote: A re-run uses the current definition.
detail.noDefinition: The definition used by this run can no longer be read; only the steps that ran are shown.
detail.polling: This run has not finished: its status refreshes on its own.
detail.acceptedBefore_one: {{count, number}} recipient was accepted before the failure — the email reached none of them.
detail.acceptedBefore_other: {{count, number}} recipients were accepted before the failure — the email reached none of them.

error.unknown: The run stopped with an error.
error.permission_denied: The person the automation runs as is not allowed to do this.
error.permission_denied_record: The person the automation runs as cannot change this record.
error.permission_denied_table: The person the automation runs as no longer has access to a table or field this step uses.
error.permission_denied_base: The person the automation runs as no longer has access to this base.
error.invalid_value: The values of this step were refused.
error.invalid_value_code: The values of this step were refused ({{code}}).
error.invalid_value_record_id: The record to update could not be found from the value given.
error.invalid_value_until: The Wait step has no valid date to wait until.
error.too_many_records: More records matched than the limit of {{limit}}; nothing was changed.
error.unsupported_function: A template uses a function that automations do not support.
error.unsupported_action: This kind of step cannot run yet.
error.internal_error: An unexpected error stopped the step.
error.smtp_not_configured: Email sending is not set up on this server.
error.smtp_temporary: The email server is temporarily unavailable.
error.smtp_rejected: The email server refused the message.
error.email_quota_exceeded: The hourly email limit was reached.
error.email_quota_exceeded_until: The hourly email limit was reached; it will be sent after {{time}}.
error.too_many_recipients_one: Too many recipients ({{count, number}}); at most {{limit}}.
error.too_many_recipients_other: Too many recipients ({{count, number}}); at most {{limit}}.
error.email_identity_unavailable: The sender identity can no longer be used.
error.email_identity_auth_failed: The mail server of the sender identity refused its credentials.
error.secret_unavailable: The Telegram bot of this step was deleted or is no longer shared with this base.
error.invalid_chat_id: The Telegram chat id is empty or invalid.
error.telegram_rate_limited: Telegram kept asking to wait (too many messages).
error.secret_unavailable_http: The secret of this HTTP step was deleted or is no longer shared with this base.
error.ssrf_blocked: The address of this URL may not be called from this server.
error.ssrf_blocked_private_address: The URL leads to a private network address that the organization's HTTP allowlist does not open.
error.ssrf_blocked_blocked_address: The URL leads to an address that can never be called (cloud metadata, broadcast…).
error.ssrf_blocked_port_not_allowed: This port can only be called when the organization's HTTP allowlist names it.
error.ssrf_blocked_invalid_url: The URL is not valid (http or https only, without user name or password).
error.ssrf_blocked_unresolvable: The host name of the URL could not be found.
error.http_timeout: The server did not answer in time.
error.http_network: The connection to the server failed.
error.http_response_too_large: The server's response was larger than 1 MB.
error.http_request_too_large: The request body was larger than 1 MB.
error.http_status: The server answered with HTTP status {{status}}.
error.rate_limited: The server asked to wait more than an hour before trying again.
error.run_timeout: The run took longer than 15 minutes and was stopped.
error.trigger_data_expired: The webhook request of this run is no longer stored (requests are kept 7 days).
error.webhook_deleted: The incoming webhook of this run was deleted.
error.invalid_definition: The definition of this run can no longer be read.
error.batch_fanout_exceeded_one: Over the limit of {{limit}} runs per batch: {{count, number}} record was skipped.
error.batch_fanout_exceeded_other: Over the limit of {{limit}} runs per batch: {{count, number}} records were skipped.
error.recheck_not_matched: After the wait, the record no longer matched the condition.
error.record_deleted: The record is no longer readable.
error.record_deleted_trashed: The record was moved to the trash while waiting.
error.automation_disabled: The automation was turned off while the run was waiting.
error.secret_host_not_allowed: The URL of this HTTP step is not an allowed host of its secret (a plain http URL needs an entry with its port): nothing was sent. Add the host to the secret in the organization settings if it is the real receiver.
error.secret_host_not_allowed_legacy_expired: The secret of this HTTP step was created before allowed hosts existed and its transition period is over: set its allowed hosts in the organization settings.
error.ai_unavailable: AI is turned off or not set up for the organization.
error.ai_unavailable_record_data_disabled: The organization does not let AI see record values.
error.ai_quota_exceeded: The AI quota of the organization for today was used up; the step was not retried.
error.ai_invalid_output: The AI did not give a valid answer; the field was not changed.
error.ai_provider_error: The AI provider refused the request.

skipReason.cannot_read_field: cannot read a field used in the message

rerun.title: Re-run?
rerun.body: A new run starts with the same trigger and the automation's current definition, with the permissions of the person it runs as.
rerun.reuse: Steps that succeeded in this run and are unchanged in the current definition are not repeated.
rerun.changed: The definition changed since this run (version {{from}} → {{to}}).

cancelRun.title: Cancel this run?
cancelRun.bodyQueued: The run has not started: none of its steps will run. You can re-run it later.
cancelRun.bodyWaiting: The run is waiting: the remaining steps will not run. You can re-run it later.

toast.conflict: This run has just changed status. The latest status is shown.
toast.gone: This run no longer exists or you no longer manage its automation.

rejectionReason.domain_unknown: the domain does not receive email
rejectionReason.too_large: message too large for the receiving server
rejectionReason.policy: blocked by the receiving server's policy
rejectionReason.sender_rejected: the receiving server refused the sender

phase.paused: Paused: the server asked to wait

phaseAt.paused: Paused: the server asked to wait (Retry-After). Next attempt at {{time}}

ssrfHint.never: This address can never be called, even with the HTTP allowlist. Change the URL of the step.
ssrfHint.host: Check the host name in the step's URL, then re-run.

http.privacy: The log keeps only the host: never the full URL, the headers or the request body.
